**React re-renders every child when the parent renders.** Same props or not — that's the default.

To skip it, wrap the child in `React.memo`. React then compares props before re-rendering.

That comparison only goes one level deep, so inline values break it:

```jsx
<Child style={{ margin: 8 }} onClick={() => save(id)} />
```

Objects, arrays and functions written inline are brand new every render. Wrap them in `useMemo` or `useCallback` and `memo` starts working.
